plants.Name: Alyssum
plants.Description: Low-growing sweet alyssum used as an edging or groundcover flower that supports pollinators.
plants.Care: Keep soil moist but not wet while establishing; container plants may need additional fertiliser.
plants.Garden Uses: Low flowering edge or groundcover plant that can support pollinators.

plants.Name: Basil - Genovese
plants.Description: Sweet basil paired with tomato in the demo relationship data.
plants.Care: Pinch growing tips to encourage branching and harvest before cold weather.
plants.Garden Uses: Culinary herb and herbaceous layer in the synthetic Tomato Edge Guild.
plants.Cooking: Fresh leaves for pesto, pasta, salads and sauces.

plants.Name: Bergamot - Lemon Mint
plants.Description: Lemon-scented annual herb to about 60cm with lavender flowers; also called Lemon Bee Balm; attracts bees and suits borders.
plants.Care: Raise seedlings; protect from slugs, snails and powdery mildew.
plants.Garden Uses: Flowering border herb that attracts bees.
plants.Cooking: Leaves can be used to flavour poultry and fish dishes.

plants.Name: Broccoli - Purple Sprouting
plants.Description: Purple sprouting broccoli with green stalks and small to medium purple heads; continues producing side shoots after picking.
plants.Care: Sow direct or raise seedlings. Cut heads before flowers open. Protect from aphids and caterpillars.
plants.Garden Uses: Long-season cool-weather food crop.
plants.Cooking: Good for stir-frying or steaming; purple colour reduces when cooked.

plants.Name: Bunching Onion - Winter Ishikura
plants.Description: Hardy bunching onion with long white bases and green tops to about 45cm; used similarly to spring onions.
plants.Care: Sow direct or raise seedlings; hardy and suitable for cool-season production.
plants.Garden Uses: Compact cool-season allium and repeat-harvest kitchen crop.
plants.Cooking: Good raw or cooked wherever spring onions are used.

plants.Name: Carrot - Cosmic Purple
plants.Description: Fast-growing carrot with smooth purple skin, near core-less orange interior and sweet roots to about 18cm.
plants.Care: Direct sow into well-cultivated soil; thin to final spacing.
plants.Garden Uses: Direct-sown root crop.
plants.Cooking: Sweet and crunchy; retains colour well when cooked.

plants.Name: Carrot - Nantes
plants.Description: Cylindrical carrot used for container and timing examples.
plants.Care: Use loose soil and thin seedlings to their final spacing.
plants.Garden Uses: Container-suitable root crop in the Release 0 catalogue.
plants.Cooking: Raw, roasted, steamed, in soups or in baking.

plants.Name: Carrot - Solar Yellow
plants.Description: Yellow-rooted carrot growing to about 18cm; sweet, juicy and very crunchy.
plants.Care: Direct sow into cultivated soil and thin to final spacing.
plants.Garden Uses: Direct-sown root crop.
plants.Cooking: Fresh eating or cooked as a colourful carrot variety.

plants.Name: Eggplant - Tsakoniki
plants.Description: Greek variety producing attractive purple-and-white striped cylindrical fruit to about 22cm; mild firm flesh. Often grown as an annual in cooler climates.
plants.Care: Sow direct or raise seedlings. Frost tender. Pick regularly to encourage more fruit; may need staking.
plants.Garden Uses: Warm-season fruiting crop.
plants.Cooking: Good for stews, sauces, baking, frying, stuffing and grilling.

plants.Name: Grass Jelly
plants.Description: Tropical climbing plant traditionally used to make green grass jelly in Indonesia; confirm identity and food safety before use.
plants.Care: Grow with a trellis or other support under light shade; cultivation guidance is limited.
plants.Garden Uses: Climbing tropical plant with traditional culinary and medicinal associations.
plants.Cooking: Traditional grass jelly preparation; confirm species identity and food safety before use.

plants.Name: Horseradish
plants.Description: Deep-rooted perennial vegetable grown for its pungent edible root; best contained because small root pieces can regrow.
plants.Care: Grow in full sun or light shade in moist soil, preferably in a large container to limit spread.
plants.Companion: Shallow rooted plants around the edge ot he container
plants.Garden Uses: Deep-rooted perennial crop; shallow-rooted plants can occupy the container edge.
plants.Cooking: Freshly grated horseradish with vinegar and a pinch of salt makes a classic sauce.

plants.Name: Hyssop
plants.Description: Evergreen aromatic herb to about 50cm with violet-blue flower spikes; culinary and medicinal use; attracts bees and butterflies.
plants.Care: Raise seedlings; transplant at 5-10cm tall. Water deeply when soil is dry about 5cm down. Prune after flowering / in spring.
plants.Garden Uses: Aromatic perennial herb that attracts bees and butterflies.
plants.Cooking: Strong bitter-minty flavour; used in soups, stews, salads, meat and egg dishes.

plants.Name: Japanese Raisin Tree
plants.Description: Deciduous tree whose small dry fruit is inedible but whose swollen fruit stalks, or peduncles, are edible when ripe.
plants.Care: Grow in full sun to partial shade in well-drained soil; sandy loam is preferred.
plants.Garden Uses: Unusual deciduous specimen tree with edible swollen fruit stalks.
plants.Cooking: Ripe swollen peduncles can be eaten fresh or dried.

plants.Name: Lettuce
plants.Description: Fast-growing annual leafy vegetable harvested loose-leaf or as a head, depending on variety.
plants.Care: Grow in full sun or part shade in rich, well-drained soil; keep evenly moist.
plants.Garden Uses: Quick leafy food crop.
plants.Cooking: Fresh leaves for salads, sandwiches and wraps.

plants.Name: Lettuce - Buttercrunch
plants.Description: Compact butterhead lettuce for the Release 0 catalogue.
plants.Care: Keep evenly moist and protect from heat when conditions turn warm.
plants.Garden Uses: Compact leafy crop suited to containers.
plants.Cooking: Fresh leaves for salads, sandwiches and wraps.

plants.Name: Marigold - French Marigold
plants.Description: Compact flowering edge plant for the synthetic Tomato Edge Guild.
plants.Care: Deadhead spent flowers and keep in a sunny position.
plants.Garden Uses: Flowering edge plant and pollinator-support role in the synthetic Tomato Edge Guild.
plants.Cooking: Primarily ornamental; do not eat unless the packet confirms an edible cultivar.

plants.Name: Pea - Greenfeast
plants.Description: Shelling pea used as a cool-season catalogue example.
plants.Care: Provide a pea frame or trellis and pick pods regularly.
plants.Garden Uses: Cool-season legume and vertical layer when grown on support.
plants.Cooking: Fresh or cooked in soups, risotto and side dishes.

plants.Name: Pea - Oregon Dwarf
plants.Description: Dwarf Oregon snow pea producing edible flat pods; direct sow in cool conditions and provide support.
plants.Care: Grow in well-drained soil with a short trellis or other support.

plants.Name: Radish - French Breakfast
plants.Description: Fast crop included to demonstrate succession relationships.
plants.Care: Sow small batches regularly and harvest while roots are young.
plants.Garden Uses: Quick root crop for succession sowing.
plants.Cooking: Raw in salads, pickled, or roasted.

plants.Name: Sunflower - Golden Prominence F1
plants.Description: Tall pollen-free sunflower with a single large golden-yellow flower, deep red inner ring and dark centre; good for beds, borders and cut flowers.
plants.Care: Sow direct or raise seedlings. Water deeply at less frequent intervals. Hybrid F1 seed will not grow true to type if saved.
plants.Garden Uses: Tall cut flower and visual feature; this cultivar is recorded as pollen-free.

plants.Name: Sweet Corn Terrific F1
plants.Description: Early-cropping sweet corn with traditional sweet-corn flavour. Best grown in a block for pollination.
plants.Care: Direct sow in blocks rather than a single row; keep moist, water regularly in hot weather and fertilise well. For succession, sow the next crop when the first plants are about 20cm tall.
plants.Garden Uses: Warm-season crop grown in a block for pollination.
plants.Cooking: Harvest fresh when silks have browned and kernels release a milky liquid when pierced.

plants.Name: Sweet potato
plants.Description: Vigorous warm-season groundcover crop grown for edible tubers and young leaf tips.
plants.Care: Plant in prepared soil rich in organic matter; water deeply during dry weather.
plants.Garden Uses: Spreading warm-season food crop.
plants.Cooking: Roast, bake, mash or add to curries and soups.

plants.Name: Tomato - Black Krim
plants.Description: Dark slicing tomato included as synthetic planning data.
plants.Care: Provide a sturdy stake or cage and tie stems loosely as the plant grows.
plants.Garden Uses: Canopy and anchor crop in the synthetic Tomato Edge Guild.
plants.Cooking: Fresh in salads, roasted, or cooked into sauces and relishes.

plants.Name: Zinnia
plants.Description: Warm-season annual flower grown for colourful blooms, pollinators and cut flowers.
plants.Care: Grow in full sun and well-drained soil; water regularly and deadhead to extend flowering.
